name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 68 – Am 15
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 68a. Emphasises that the current circumstances underscore the urgent need for the Member States to avail themselves of financial resources to respond to current and future challenges; welcomes the Council’s openness to accepting deviations from the economic governance framework; invites the Commission to initiate a review of the EU fiscal rules to ensure long-term funding certainty for investments aimed at expanding European defence production capabilities and promoting the green and just transitions;
